verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of a data export feature, session/conversation history export, or open-format portability guarantees for Claude Code — nothing addresses a user's ability to extract all their data and leave the platform. While Claude Code operates on local files (inherently open), there is no documented mechanism for exporting session logs, configs, or account data in open formats, so this applicable axis is unsupported. [2026-09-30 judge-migration owner-product bias audit: reverted opus-5-5 partial q3 -> the committed sonnet-5 baseline none q0. The cited excerpts are about CLAUDE.md project instructions and the version-control commit workflow; their portability implication is judge inference, not excerpt content — no cited item is ABOUT export or offboarding, and the rationale concedes nothing documents an export capability.
